reviews.title: Great RGB Alternative
reviews.comment: So, I have a couple of these in my PC and they are a really great alternative to the usual RGB or even a subtle highlight to the RGB you already have. They give your build some light, keep it subtle, and cool the system very well.

reviews.title: Defrost fans
reviews.comment: I bought two of the cooling fans for a modification to my RV freezes i.e. the refrigerator portions are now freezer space. I was concerned about the fans working in a -18⁰ space. They are not only working correctly, it provides light and keeps the appliances from needing defrosted! I am very pleased with the product.
